title: Polish Smoked Beef Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful Polish-inspired beef bake with a smoky twist. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced beef, sliced Polish sausage, chopped onion, smoked paprika, and bake rub. Toss until evenly coated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the beef is cooked through.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving.
